# Stitchr

> Screenshot-composition CLI for humans and AI agents. Combines local PNG/JPEG files into grids, stacks, freeform arrangements, or diagonal split comparisons, with versioned JSON output and stable error codes.

## Docs

- [Agent usage guide](https://github.com/igorfil/Stitchr/blob/main/docs/agents.md): workflow, JSON contract, error codes, and composition rules. Start here.
- [Runnable cookbook](https://github.com/igorfil/Stitchr/blob/main/docs/examples/README.md)
- [Machine-readable cookbook](https://github.com/igorfil/Stitchr/blob/main/docs/examples/cases.json)
- [README](https://github.com/igorfil/Stitchr/blob/main/README.md): installation and options overview
